description:
Genebank accessions from Genesys (Crop Trust), live: full passport data (holder, accession number and names,
taxon, biological status, country and site of origin, coordinates, pedigree), whether the accession is available,
in the Multilateral System (SMTA) and safety-duplicated in Svalbard, whether the holder takes requests through
Genesys, a DOI where assigned, and the climate at the collection site (WorldClim: mean temperature, temperature
extremes, precipitation). accession: accession number (e.g. 'PI 591780', 'IG 32990'); holder: FAO WIEWS code
(e.g. USA029, LBN002, AUS165) to make it unique; name: free text (e.g. 'Chinese Spring') when the number is not
known; crop: Genesys crop code (wheat, barley, chickpea, lentil, pea ...) to narrow a name search.
name: genesys_accession
